newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom placement set for early October.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom placement set for early October.

text.p: Russian gas monopoly RAO Gazprom will place depositary receipts in early October on the London Stock Exchange or through a consortium of international investment banks, a source close to the deal said on Friday.
"Preparations for the placement are in the final stage, they are practically completed," the source said.
The source declined to give any terms of the placement, but said a memorandum for investors prepared by Gazprom would be published in the immediate future.
The source said Gazprom officials headed by board member Alexander Semenyaka met the banking consortium and the London Stock Exchange in London on September 18 to discuss a listing.
The consortium's global coordinators are Morgan Stanley and Dresdner Bank AG's Kleinwort Benson.
"Since September 18 the banks have started pre-marketing work with potential investors," the source said.
